bites.title: Light is everything
bites.body: Same object, different light, totally different mood. Painters have known this forever.

bites.title: Add a softbox
bites.body: Shift+A, Light, Area. A flat, glowing panel, like a photographer's softbox.

bites.title: Hang it up
bites.body: G, Z, and lift the Area light to at least 3 meters up. It points down by default.

bites.title: Turn it up
bites.body: Properties, green lightbulb tab (Object Data). Set Power to 500 W.
bites.hint: The green lightbulb tab only shows while the light is selected.

bites.title: Warm it up
bites.body: Click the light's Color and pick a warm orange.

bites.title: Soften the shadows
bites.body: Set the Area light's Size to 4. Bigger light, softer shadows. That's the whole secret of portrait lighting.

bites.title: Dim the sky
bites.body: Click the red globe tab (World). Set Strength to 0.2. The ambient fill drops and your Area light takes over.

bites.title: Lesson 10: cleared
bites.body:
Rendered view, Area lights, power, color, size, and the World. You're lighting like a photographer.
